title: Francesca da Rimini
facts: It was premiered at the Teatro Regio in Turin on 19 February 1914 and is still staged occasionally.
Francesca da Rimini, Op. 4, is an opera in four acts, composed by Riccardo Zandonai, with a libretto by Tito Ricordi II, after D'Annunzio's play Francesca da Rimini.
